title: High school students currently using e-cigarettes (percent)

source.name: National Youth Tobacco Survey (NYTS)
source.publisher: U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC)

notes: Current (past-30-day) e-cigarette use among US high school students. 2011 and 2018 figures from CDC MMWR 'Vital Signs: Tobacco Product Use Among Middle and High School Students -- United States, 2011-2018' (68(6):157); 2017 figure (11.7%) and 2019 peak (27.5%) from CDC MMWR Vol. 68 No. 12 (2019 NYTS). All CDC-reported, none illustrative.
